records.claim: Nirmatrelvir and ritonavir are medications that have been used together to treat COVID-19 (the illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus). The combination of nirmatrelvir and ritonavir is sold under the brand name Paxlovid®. To be most effective, nirmatrelvir/ritonavir treatment should be started as soon as possible after a diagnosis of COVID-19 and within 5 days of the start of symptoms. For more information on COVID-19, please the fact sheet at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/covid-19/.
